title: Scene
description: One scene within a video-manifest. Narration/overlay text must be English (channel policy). Duration must trace to measured audio, never an estimate.

narration_text.description: Spoken narration for this scene. Must be English.

base_description.description: Scene-specific visual description, before CHARACTER_ANCHOR/COLOR_ANCHOR/SAFETY_SUFFIX are appended (see prompts/STAGE-PROMPTS.md).

uses_character_anchor.description: Must be true whenever the character appears in this scene.

uses_safety_suffix.description: SAFETY_SUFFIX is always required — never optional.

reference_image_paths.description: Reference image(s) passed to generate_with_reference() for character-identity lock.

requires_text_adjacent_spotcheck.description: True if the scene contains a screen/gauge/dial/sign — triggers the mandatory visual spot-check for baked-in text (see TECHNICAL-SPEC-EN.md section 4).

mouth_box_ref.description: Identifier for a hand-measured MouthBox for this specific scene image. Not auto-detected (see character_rig.py docstring).

limb_box_ref.description: Identifier for a hand-measured LimbBox, sized for max swing angle x distance from pivot, not just resting silhouette.

text.description: Deterministically derived from narration_text; not a free LLM generation (see TECHNICAL-SPEC-EN.md section 8).

duration_source.description: Always measured_audio; a wpm-estimated or hand-guessed duration must never be persisted here.

audio_file_path.description: Path to the measured Kokoro narration audio this scene's duration was derived from.
